enemies.name: 盗墓苦役
enemies.appearance: Hunched undead gravedigger in a ragged brown hood, rusty shovel, rope belt and a small stolen funerary coin pouch.
enemies.counter: 防住前排，趁其掘土蓄力时集火。

enemies.name: 腐锹尸
enemies.appearance: Bulky moss covered corpse, broken iron spade fused into one forearm, exposed ribs, pale jade grave fungus.
enemies.counter: 净化前排的诅咒，可恢复受疗并解除弩手的追击优先级。
enemies.mechanic: 30% 概率向最前方对手施加 1 层诅咒，使其无法受疗。守夜弩骸会优先射击被诅咒者。

enemies.name: 墓碑盾骸
enemies.appearance: Skeleton guard carrying a cracked rectangular tombstone as a tower shield, dented helmet, dark blue burial cloth.
enemies.counter: 用魔法攻击盾骸，能打断它持续保护同伴。
enemies.mechanic: 开战自带 4 点护盾。30% 概率为己方攻击最高者增加 4 点护盾。

enemies.name: 锈棘枪骸
enemies.appearance: Lean skeletal pikeman with a long rusted thorn tipped spear, faded burgundy tabard and thorn wrapped ribs.
enemies.counter: 破绽会被下一次伤害消耗，避免脆弱成员顶在前排。

enemies.name: 守夜弩骸
enemies.appearance: Skeletal night sentry with a heavy burial crossbow, torn black cape, a single amber eye and quiver of bone bolts.
enemies.counter: 关注前排的诅咒和后排的蓄力箭。
enemies.mechanic: 守夜骨矢优先射击被诅咒者，条件相同时选物防最低者。另有 25% 概率蓄力，下次行动狙击后排。

enemies.name: 灯骨引路人
enemies.appearance: Tall skeletal guide in a blue green burial robe, crooked staff holding a turquoise ghost lantern, trailing funeral ribbons.
enemies.counter: 用物理攻击尽早打断后排的禁疗来源。

enemies.name: 挽歌学徒
enemies.appearance: Masked young ghost chorister with a torn violet hymnbook, wax sealed mouth, silver tuning fork and flowing frayed sleeves.
enemies.counter: 攻击最高的队员会被萎靡，净化或先击倒学徒。

enemies.name: 缝尸仆役
enemies.appearance: Small stitched corpse servant in a stained linen apron, huge curved surgical needle, spool of red thread strapped to its back.
enemies.counter: 集火残血，或用诅咒阻止缝补。

enemies.name: 裹尸织女
enemies.appearance: Veiled spectral weaver with long pale fingers, floating spindle, layers of indigo funeral shrouds and silver thread loops.
enemies.counter: 护盾能吸收伤害，优先击倒织女减少持续防护。

enemies.name: 墓蕨寄生体
enemies.appearance: Crawling grave fern parasite grown around a rib cage, root legs, curled violet spore fronds and tiny sickly green sacs.
enemies.counter: 每次喷吐施加两层中毒，及时净化并清掉毒源。

enemies.name: 食碑石像
enemies.appearance: Squat grave gargoyle with broken stone wings, a jaw full of chipped epitaph tablets, moss covered granite hide.
enemies.counter: 用魔法处理，蓄力时有一个行动窗口。

enemies.name: 腐巢渡鸦
enemies.appearance: Huge ragged black raven with a bone beak, grave ribbon on one leg, green shining eyes and thorn nest feathers.
enemies.counter: 优先保护残血角色，渡鸦本体脆弱。

enemies.name: 掘骨鬣犬
enemies.appearance: Emaciated grave hyena with exposed ivory shoulder plates, shovel shaped claws, crooked grin and a chain collar.
enemies.counter: 后排也会受攻击，别把低血角色放到队尾。

enemies.name: 磷火游魂
enemies.appearance: Floating turquoise ghost flame surrounding a cracked human skull, tiny copper censer and violet fire wisps beneath.
enemies.counter: 高特防低物防，使用弓手或近战。

enemies.name: 冻土亡灵
enemies.appearance: Frozen revenant wrapped in frost cracked burial cloth, ice covered spade staff, pale cyan bones and frozen roots.
enemies.counter: 寒冷叠到三层会冰冻，火焰可清掉寒冷并制造伤害。

enemies.name: 祷骨修女
enemies.appearance: Hollow eyed undead nun in a faded ivory and midnight blue habit, rosary made of finger bones, small silver votive lantern.
enemies.counter: 诅咒限制治疗，净化和治疗不能同时无限循环。

enemies.name: 守柩獒
enemies.appearance: Heavy undead mastiff in coffin plank armor, iron muzzle, broken funeral bells and a thick chain trailing from its collar.
enemies.counter: 耐久高但输出一般，先击倒身后的支援。

enemies.name: 裂棺行尸
enemies.appearance: Large corpse trapped in a split upright wooden coffin, protruding nailed arms, broken coffin lid held like a club.
enemies.counter: 重击需要蓄力，魔法能越过其物理防御。

enemies.name: 锈链狱卒
enemies.appearance: Faceless grave jailer in a rusted iron hood, oversized chain hook, dangling burial keys and dark leather apron.
enemies.counter: 束链只使一名前排眩晕，优先清掉控制源。

enemies.name: 送葬鼓手
enemies.appearance: Skeletal funeral drummer in a ragged purple uniform, rib bone drumsticks, chest mounted weathered skin drum with silver mourning tassels.
enemies.counter: 鼓点只强化一名攻击最高的队友，优先击倒鼓手或主输出。

enemies.name: 白蜡侍者
enemies.appearance: Thin wax effigy attendant with a melting candle crown, white wax robes, brass candle snuffer and eerie amber flames.
enemies.counter: 烛火会点名后排，保持队尾生命。

enemies.name: 雾喉怨灵
enemies.appearance: Long jawed floating wraith, smoky translucent teal robe, a hollow throat glowing lavender, trailing fingers and funeral veil.
enemies.counter: 低血队友会被禁疗，先保护再用物理输出除掉怨灵。

enemies.name: 赎骨商贩
enemies.appearance: Stooped skeletal peddler carrying a wooden rack of tiny bones, cracked scales and tarnished coins, moss green merchant cloak.
enemies.counter: 护盾保护最低生命比例队友，可用群攻减少其收益。

enemies.name: 抬棺四侍
enemies.appearance: One composite monster of four small pallbearer skeletons fused beneath a single ornate iron bound coffin, eight arms moving as one unit, jade ghostlight.
enemies.counter: 占两格，蓄力压棺前可集火或眩晕，避免前两人同时残血。

enemies.name: 墓钟敲击者
enemies.appearance: Towering hollow armored bell keeper dragging a small cracked cemetery bell and holding a heavy wooden mallet, verdigris bronze and indigo cloth.
enemies.counter: 群体钟波提前一行动预警，治疗和护盾应覆盖全队。

enemies.name: 缝魂医师
enemies.appearance: Tall spectral mortician with an ivory bird mask, articulated surgical needle staff, floating red soul sutures and a dark teal embroidered medical coat.
enemies.counter: 治疗数值高，诅咒与集火有效，物理攻击针对低防。

enemies.name: 哭墙石像
enemies.appearance: Massive kneeling cemetery gargoyle carrying a fragment of a weeping memorial wall, stone face with luminous cyan tear streams, folded jagged wings.
enemies.counter: 法术击穿物防，寒冷只覆盖前两名，避免多人叠满。

enemies.name: 巡墓刽子手
enemies.appearance: Broad hooded grave executioner wearing a tattered black purple robe, heavy crescent execution axe, burial tags and a chain of iron grave keys.
enemies.counter: 斩首追踪低血目标且蓄力一行动，及时治疗或施加防护。

enemies.mechanic: 葬王点名生命比例最低者，下次行动审判。生命过半或有护盾可获赦免。
enemies.name: 无名葬王
enemies.appearance: Majestic undead funeral king with a fractured obsidian crown, empty face behind a silver death mask, huge chipped burial greatsword, black royal mantle threaded with turquoise soul lights.
enemies.counter: 在宣判前治疗被点名者，或为其保留护盾。

enemies.mechanic: 每隔一次行动为存活随从加4盾，自身回复4生命。随从阵亡后改为哀悼，自身获得1层破绽。
enemies.name: 守墓圣母
enemies.appearance: Colossal mourning cemetery matron in layered ivory and deep blue funeral robes, pale porcelain death mask, halo made of grave keys, cradle shaped reliquary full of cold ghost lights and long spectral hands.
enemies.counter: 优先击倒随从，让圣母失去回复并暴露破绽。
